dialogue.content: こんにちは。本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: お時間になったら開始でよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Shall we start when it's time?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です！
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine!

dialogue.content: では時間になったら始めますね！
dialogue.English: Okay, we'll start when it's time!

dialogue.content: はい、わかりました！
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand!

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。本日はどういった相談でしょうか。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: こんにちは。性別の事で、親に言えずに悩んでいます
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm struggling because I can't tell my parents about my gender.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 少し具体的に伺ってもよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Would it be okay if I asked for a few more details?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 戸籍上は女性です
dialogue.English: Legally, I'm female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 実際は違います
dialogue.English: But that's not who I really am.

dialogue.content: 性自認は男性ということですか？
dialogue.English: So you're saying your gender identity is male?

dialogue.content: はい、そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 話していただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 失礼ですが、ご相談者様は今おいくつなのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: May I ask how old you are?

dialogue.content: 今25です
dialogue.English: I'm 25 now.

dialogue.content: いつ頃から性別の違いを感じ始めたのですか？
dialogue.English: When did you start to feel this difference in your gender?

dialogue.content: 中学ぐらいで確信した感じです
dialogue.English: I became sure of it around middle school.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: では約10年ほどお悩みということでしょうか。
dialogue.English: So you've been struggling with this for about 10 years?

dialogue.content: そうですね、自分が恋愛を始めてから、そんな感じです
dialogue.English: That's right, it's been like that since I started dating.

dialogue.content: 質問ばかりで申し訳ないですが、
dialogue.English: I'm sorry for all the questions, but...

dialogue.content: いえいえ
dialogue.English: No, no, it's fine.

dialogue.content: 恋愛対象は女性になるのですか？
dialogue.English: Are you romantically interested in women?

dialogue.content: そうです、女性だけです
dialogue.English: Yes, only women.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。ですと、
dialogue.English: I see. In that case...

dialogue.content: 戸籍上、親に「恋人です」と紹介もしにくいですよね、、、
dialogue.English: Given your legal status, it must be hard to introduce someone to your parents as "my partner," right...

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: そのお気持ちすごくわかります。
dialogue.English: I can really understand how you feel.

dialogue.content: 以前パートナーと同棲してた時も、隠してました
dialogue.English: When I lived with a partner before, I had to hide it.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 隠しながらはおつらいですよね。
dialogue.English: It must be painful to have to hide it.

dialogue.content: そうなんです…
dialogue.English: It is...

dialogue.content: 完全に私事ですが、
dialogue.English: This is completely personal, but...

dialogue.content: 私も性自認が違います。
dialogue.English: my gender identity is also different from my assigned sex.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか！
dialogue.English: Oh, really?

dialogue.content: それは心強いです
dialogue.English: That's very encouraging.

dialogue.content: なのでそのお気持ちすごくわかります。
dialogue.English: So I really do understand how you feel.

dialogue.content: 良かったです、なんかわかってもらえて
dialogue.English: I'm so glad you understand.

dialogue.content: 私の場合は戸籍男性の中身女性なので、
dialogue.English: In my case, I'm legally male but identify as female,

dialogue.content: ご相談者様とは真逆になりますが、
dialogue.English: so it's the opposite of your situation,

dialogue.content: あー、なるほど！
dialogue.English: Ah, I see!

dialogue.content: なんとかお力になれたらなと思います。
dialogue.English: I hope I can be of some help.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Thank you!

dialogue.content: なかなか話せないので…
dialogue.English: It's not something I can talk about easily...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。。
dialogue.English: I understand...

dialogue.content: 周りの方に、
dialogue.English: To the people around you,

dialogue.content: 性別のことを打ち明けたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: have you ever come out to anyone about your gender?

dialogue.content: 同じ仲間には話してます
dialogue.English: I've told friends in the community.

dialogue.content: 職場では言ってません
dialogue.English: I haven't told anyone at work.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: でも、外見でわかってると思います、みんな
dialogue.English: But I think everyone can tell from my appearance.

dialogue.content: 男性的な見た目ということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mean you have a more masculine appearance?

dialogue.content: そうですね、とても男性寄りにしてます
dialogue.English: Yes, I present very much on the masculine side.

dialogue.content: でも、女の子らしい名前なので、みんな探り探りというか…
dialogue.English: But since I have a feminine name, everyone seems to be feeling things out...

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ハッキリ聞かれた事はないです
dialogue.English: No one has ever asked me directly.

dialogue.content: でも男性らしい見た目がいいというか、それがご相談者様の姿なのですものね。
dialogue.English: But having a masculine presentation feels right for you; that's who you are, isn't it?

dialogue.content: これが自分にとって自然というか、しっくりきます
dialogue.English: This feels natural and right for me.

dialogue.content: そう思った格好で過ごすのは素敵だと思います！
dialogue.English: I think it's wonderful to live and dress in a way that feels true to yourself!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 私は会社に打ち明けましたが、
dialogue.English: I came out to my company, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 格好は制限されているので、少しうらやましいです＾＾
dialogue.English: but my attire is restricted, so I'm a little envious. :)

dialogue.content: えー、そうなんですね！
dialogue.English: Oh, really!

dialogue.content: こういった性の問題は理解が難しいですよね。。。
dialogue.English: Issues around gender like this can be hard for others to understand...

dialogue.content: 正解ってないのかもしれないけれど、どう過ごしたら良いのか迷う事は多いですよね…
dialogue.English: There may not be a right answer, but it's easy to feel lost about how to live...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。。
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly...

dialogue.content: 親に言えないとのことでしたが、
dialogue.English: You mentioned you can't tell your parents, but

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 逆に、言わないといけない理由などはあるのですか？
dialogue.English: On the other hand, is there a reason you feel you have to tell them?

dialogue.content: 正直、いつのタイミングで言うものかわからないというか
dialogue.English: Honestly, I don't know when the right time to tell them would be.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm.

dialogue.content: やっぱり、いずれはパートナーも紹介したいですし
dialogue.English: And, well, I do want to introduce a partner to them eventually.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 早く言った方が楽という気持ちと、親がどんな気持ちになるか…と考える気持ちで
dialogue.English: Part of me thinks it would be easier to tell them sooner, but I also worry about how they’ll feel...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm.

dialogue.content: 何て言ったら良いのかなーと
dialogue.English: I just wonder what the best way to say it is.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。悩んでしまいますよね。。。
dialogue.English: Right. It's something you can really agonize over...

dialogue.content: 特に母親は絶対わかってると思いますが、避けます、恋愛の話など
dialogue.English: I’m pretty sure my mother knows, but she avoids topics like dating.

dialogue.content: だから、聞きたくないんだろうなーと
dialogue.English: So I feel like she probably doesn't want to hear about it.

dialogue.content: わかっているというのは「ご相談者様が実は男性」ということですか？
dialogue.English: When you say she knows, do you mean she senses that you identify as male?

dialogue.content: 男性の感覚なんだろう、と思ってると思います
dialogue.English: I think she probably thinks I have a 'male sensibility' or something like that.

dialogue.content: 女性しか恋愛対象にならないのは、わかってるかわかりません
dialogue.English: I'm not sure if she knows that I'm only attracted to women.

dialogue.content: なるほどです。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 男性らしいとは思われていそうなのですね。
dialogue.English: So she likely sees you as masculine.

dialogue.content: そうですね、外見がそうなので
dialogue.English: Yes, because of my appearance.

dialogue.content: なるほど。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 少し話がそれますが、
dialogue.English: This is a bit of a tangent, but

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 職場でカミングアウトしてないことがつらいと感じることはありますか？
dialogue.English: do you ever find it painful not to be out at work?

dialogue.content: 今はもう、ないです
dialogue.English: Not anymore.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 新しい人が入ってくると、探られてる感じはしますが
dialogue.English: When new people join, I feel like they're trying to figure me out.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm.

dialogue.content: ほとんどの人達は、男性なんだろう、みたいな感じでいる様です
dialogue.English: But most people seem to just assume I'm a man.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。では障害というか、壁に感じるのはやはり親御さんへのカミングアウトなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So the obstacle, the wall you feel, is really about coming out to your parents.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよねー
dialogue.English: Yes, that's it.

dialogue.content: 言えたら楽だけど、言うのは怖い
dialogue.English: It would be a relief to tell them, but it's scary.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 傷つくのかなーとか、思います
dialogue.English: I wonder if they'll be hurt.

dialogue.content: お気持ちわかります。
dialogue.English: I understand how you feel.

dialogue.content: 私は親にカミングアウトしたのですが、
dialogue.English: I did come out to my parents,

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！
dialogue.English: You did!

dialogue.content: とても怖かったです。
dialogue.English: I was very scared.

dialogue.content: いう前は。
dialogue.English: Before I told them.

dialogue.content: どのタイミングで決心したのですか？
dialogue.English: What made you decide to do it?

dialogue.content: パニック発作という病気になりまして、
dialogue.English: I developed panic attacks,

dialogue.content: それきっかけです。
dialogue.English: and that was the trigger.

dialogue.content: あー、そうなんですね…それはきつかったですね…
dialogue.English: Ah, I see... That must have been really tough...

dialogue.content: パニック障害です。失礼。
dialogue.English: Panic disorder, excuse me.

dialogue.content: 自分の格好と性別が合わないので、
dialogue.English: Because my appearance and my gender didn't align,

dialogue.content: 体が限界を迎えた感じがしました。
dialogue.English: I felt like my body had reached its limit.

dialogue.content: わかります、とても
dialogue.English: I understand that very well.

dialogue.content: 周りにもいます
dialogue.English: I know people who have gone through that.

dialogue.content: なので親にもカミングアウトしないといけないなと思いまして。
dialogue.English: So I felt I had to come out to my parents.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね！
dialogue.English: Oh, you do!

dialogue.content: 何かきっかけがないと、やはり言いにくいですよね…
dialogue.English: Without some kind of trigger, it's hard to bring it up, isn't it...

dialogue.content: そうですね、、、
dialogue.English: Yes, it is...

dialogue.content: ちなみに私の場合、
dialogue.English: In my case, by the way,

dialogue.content: 親に言ったら「あ、そーなん？そんな気はしてたけど。」と軽く終わりました　笑
dialogue.English: when I told my parents, they just said, "Oh, really? We kind of thought so," and that was it, haha.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！
dialogue.English: Really!

dialogue.content: 待ってくれてたんですかね、言うの
dialogue.English: Maybe they were waiting for you to tell them?

dialogue.content: かもしれないです。
dialogue.English: Possibly.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、いくつぐらいの時に言ったんですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, how old were you when you told them?

dialogue.content: 26歳ですね。
dialogue.English: I was 26.

dialogue.content: まさに、自分の、今！ですね
dialogue.English: That's exactly my age now!

dialogue.content: 丁度ご相談者様の年齢くらいの時です。
dialogue.English: It was right around your age.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なるほどー
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 偶然ですね＾＾
dialogue.English: What a coincidence. :)

dialogue.content: 本当に！
dialogue.English: It really is!

dialogue.content: もしかしたら、その年代が丁度転機なのかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: Perhaps that age is a natural turning point.

dialogue.content: そうなんですかねー
dialogue.English: Maybe so.

dialogue.content: もしご相談者様がカミングアウトしたとして、
dialogue.English: If you were to come out,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 親御さんはどういう反応しそうですか？
dialogue.English: how do you think your parents would react?

dialogue.content: 想像で結構です。
dialogue.English: Just your best guess is fine.

dialogue.content: うーん、やはり、母親は泣くと思います
dialogue.English: Hmm, I think my mother would cry.

dialogue.content: 今も話を避けますし
dialogue.English: She avoids the topic even now.

dialogue.content: 父親は、もっと聞きたくないのかも
dialogue.English: My father might want to hear it even less.

dialogue.content: 泣くというのは、悲しくてでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Do you think she would cry out of sadness?

dialogue.content: 大切な女の子だったから
dialogue.English: Because I was her precious little girl.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: では逆に、考えてみましょう。
dialogue.English: Then let's think about it from the opposite perspective.

dialogue.content: だから、見た目が男寄りでも、知らなきゃ希望がある、というか
dialogue.English: So, even if I look masculine, as long as she doesn't know, there's still hope, in a way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なるほど。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: かぶってしまいましたね。すみません。
dialogue.English: Oh, we spoke at the same time. I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: いえいえ
dialogue.English: No, no, it's okay.

dialogue.content: もしご相談者様に子供がいたとして、
dialogue.English: If you had a child,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 自分の子供が「性別違うんだ」と言ってきたらどう感じるでしょう。
dialogue.English: and your child came to you and said, "My gender is different," how would you feel?

dialogue.content: 自分はそれで苦しんでいるので、とても力になりたいです
dialogue.English: Since I've suffered because of it, I would want to be very supportive.

dialogue.content: でも、親はそうじゃないからなーと
dialogue.English: But I don't think my parents are like that.

dialogue.content: そう思うのですね。
dialogue.English: That's how you see it.

dialogue.content: はい、思いますね
dialogue.English: Yes, I do.

dialogue.content: では自分の子供に「隠し事をされている」と感じたらどう思うでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Then how would you feel if you felt your child was hiding something from you?

dialogue.content: うーん、どうかなー
dialogue.English: Hmm, I wonder...

dialogue.content: 子供が苦しいだろうな、と思います
dialogue.English: I’d think my child must be hurting.

dialogue.content: そう思うのですね。
dialogue.English: That's what you'd think.

dialogue.content: はい、想像ですけど
dialogue.English: Yes, just imagining.

dialogue.content: ええ。想像で大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes. Imagining is fine.

dialogue.content: 苦しむ子供を見るのは絶対つらいですよね。
dialogue.English: It would be very painful to see your child suffering.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうね、きっと
dialogue.English: I’m sure it would be.

dialogue.content: お母さまはご相談者様のことにうすうす感づいているとのことでしたが、
dialogue.English: You mentioned that your mother has a vague sense of things,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 事実を知りたくないつらさではなく、
dialogue.English: could it be that it's not the pain of not wanting to know the truth,

dialogue.content: 自分の子供が苦しんでいるつらさという可能性はないでしょうか。
dialogue.English: but the pain of seeing her child suffer?

dialogue.content: どうですかねーずっと苦しんできたけれど、22で家を出るまで
dialogue.English: I’m not sure... I'd been struggling the whole time, but until I left home at 22,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm.

dialogue.content: もっと女の子らしくしなさい！と、色んな事に、よく言われてました…
dialogue.English: she often told me to be more ladylike in all sorts of ways...

dialogue.content: 服装や態度、言葉遣いなど
dialogue.English: My clothes, my demeanor, the way I spoke, things like that.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: だから、息苦しかったです
dialogue.English: So it felt suffocating.

dialogue.content: 私も男らしく！とずっと言われていました。
dialogue.English: I was always told to "be more manly," too.

dialogue.content: やっぱそうですか…
dialogue.English: You too, huh...

dialogue.content: 息苦しいですよね。。。
dialogue.English: It’s suffocating, isn’t it...

dialogue.content: らしさ、って、よくわからないですよね
dialogue.English: I don't really understand what 'acting like' a certain gender even means.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 誰が決めたのか、決めた人を恨みます。
dialogue.English: I resent whoever decided these things.

dialogue.content: ほんとですね
dialogue.English: Truly.

dialogue.content: ですがそんな私の母親でしたが、
dialogue.English: But even though my mother was like that,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: カミングアウトしたら「話してくれてありがとう。つらかったよね。」と言ってくれました。
dialogue.English: when I came out, she said, "Thank you for telling me. It must have been so hard for you."

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！男らしく！と言ってたのは、お母さんですか？
dialogue.English: Really! Was it your mother who told you to "be more manly"?

dialogue.content: ええ。女っぽいのに男の子として扱わなきゃって思うと男らしくしなさいと、
dialogue.English: Yes. She said that because she felt she had to treat me as a boy even though I seemed feminine,

dialogue.content: きつくいってしまったと
dialogue.English: she ended up being too hard on me.

dialogue.content: あー
dialogue.English: Ah.

dialogue.content: 生まれた性別らしくしないと、本人が大変と思ったんですかね
dialogue.English: Maybe she thought it would be hard for you if you didn't act like your assigned sex at birth.

dialogue.content: そうみたいです。もしかしたらご相談者様のお母さま自身も、ある意味似た悩みがあるかもしれません。
dialogue.English: It seems so. It's possible your mother has, in her own way, a similar worry.

dialogue.content: あー、なるほどなー、そういう可能性もあるんですね
dialogue.English: Ah, I see. That's a possibility.

dialogue.content: なのでいっそ「男として扱って！」と言ってしまったほうがお互い楽かもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: So it might be easier for both of you if you just said, "Please treat me as a man!"

dialogue.content: 本当は、結婚の事など、将来の夢が親なりにあるのかな、と思って
dialogue.English: The truth is, I think my parents probably have their own dreams for my future, like marriage and things.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 色んな事を考えると、なかなか言い出せないですね…
dialogue.English: When I think about all that, it's really hard to bring it up...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: でも極論ですが、ご相談者様の人生はご相談者様のものです。
dialogue.English: But to put it bluntly, your life is your own.

dialogue.content: それは、とてもそうですね
dialogue.English: That's very true.

dialogue.content: 申し訳ない気持ちもあるんです
dialogue.English: I also feel guilty.

dialogue.content: だからといって、変えられないけど…
dialogue.English: But even so, I can't change who I am...

dialogue.content: ご相談者様自身が幸せなら、ご両親も納得してくださるのではないのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: If you yourself are happy, don't you think your parents might come to accept it?

dialogue.content: そうだと良いな、と思います
dialogue.English: I hope so.

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: デリケートな問題なので、
dialogue.English: It's a delicate issue,

dialogue.content: カミングアウトが正解とは言えませんが、
dialogue.English: so I can't say that coming out is the right answer,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 将来的にパートナーを紹介したいという希望があるのなら、
dialogue.English: but if you hope to introduce a partner in the future,

dialogue.content: カミングアウトしてしまったほうが楽なのかなとは思いましたが、いかがでしょう。
dialogue.English: it might be easier in the long run to come out. How does that idea sit with you?

dialogue.content: 楽なのは、きっと楽です、自分的には
dialogue.English: It would definitely be easier, for me personally.

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: でも、どのタイミングが良いのかなーって、迷います
dialogue.English: But I'm unsure about the right timing.

dialogue.content: タイミングは悩みますよね。
dialogue.English: Timing is tricky, isn't it.

dialogue.content: それこそ、普段の生活の中で
dialogue.English: Like, in everyday life,

dialogue.content: ちょっと話が…　っていきなり言うのか？など
dialogue.English: do I just suddenly say, "I have something to talk about..." or what?

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ちなみに私の場合ですが、
dialogue.English: By the way, in my case,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 病気きっかけとは言いましたが、
dialogue.English: I mentioned the illness was the trigger,

dialogue.content: 話したタイミングは帰省して近況報告している最中に
dialogue.English: but I told them while I was home visiting and catching up.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: さらっと「そういえば私、頭ン中女なんだ。」と言いました。
dialogue.English: I just casually said, "Oh, by the way, in my head, I'm a woman."

dialogue.content: すぐに信じてもらえたというか、本気と思ってくれましたか？
dialogue.English: Did they believe you right away, or did they take you seriously?

dialogue.content: 最初は冗談ぽく話ていて、
dialogue.English: I started by saying it jokingly,

dialogue.content: 「そういえば女っぽい部分昔からあったよね、あー、そっか、女だったんか。」ってだんだんと納得してもらいました。
dialogue.English: and then they gradually came to accept it, saying things like, "You know, you've always had a feminine side. Oh, I see, so you're a woman."

dialogue.content: 改まって言うのが怖かったので。
dialogue.English: Because I was afraid of making it a formal, serious talk.

dialogue.content: うん、うん、そうですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, yes, that makes sense.

dialogue.content: なるほどー
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: なので参考程度ですが、
dialogue.English: So, this is just for reference, but

dialogue.content: ふとした瞬間に言ってみるのはどうでしょう。
dialogue.English: how about trying to say it in a casual moment?

dialogue.content: 改まる事だけが、正解でもないというのは、新しい発見です
dialogue.English: Realizing that it doesn't have to be a formal conversation is a new discovery for me.

dialogue.content: それで進まなかったら、改まるのも、ありかもしれないですよね
dialogue.English: And if that doesn't move things forward, then a more formal talk could be an option.

dialogue.content: もちろん正解化はわからないですが、参考になったなら幸いです。
dialogue.English: Of course, I don't know if it's the right answer, but I'm glad if it was helpful.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: I agree.

dialogue.content: それも少し考えてみたいと思います
dialogue.English: I'd like to think about that a bit.

dialogue.content: ぜひ選択肢に入れてみてください＾＾
dialogue.English: Please consider it as one of your options. :)

dialogue.content: はい！ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: I will! Thank you.

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間ですが、完璧な結論を出せず申し訳ありません。
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up, and I'm sorry I couldn't offer you a perfect conclusion.

dialogue.content: とんでもないです
dialogue.English: Not at all.

dialogue.content: 何か今聞きたいことなどありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else you'd like to ask right now?

dialogue.content: いえ、新しい発見をありがとうございました
dialogue.English: No, thank you for the new perspective.

dialogue.content: そういっていただけるとありがたいです。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear you say that.

dialogue.content: また考えてみて、悩むようでしたらぜひまたいらしてください。
dialogue.English: If you think it over and find yourself struggling again, please feel free to come back.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you!

dialogue.content: それでは本日はここで失礼します。
dialogue.English: Well then, we'll end here for today.

dialogue.content: ご相談者様の未来が明るくなることを陰ながら祈っています。
dialogue.English: I'll be cheering for you from the sidelines for a bright future.

dialogue.content: がんばります！
dialogue.English: I'll do my best!

dialogue.content: はい！それでは失礼します。
dialogue.English: Yes! Well then, take care.

dialogue.content: (ロールプレイありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play.)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそ、ありがとうございました！)
dialogue.English: (Thank you, too!)

dialogue.content: (ではロールプレイ終了します。)
dialogue.English: (Then we'll end the role-play here.)
